title: Z-Tornado
author: Oliver Feiler, Rene Puls, and Sophie Fruehling
description:
A two-player weather action game.

This is a fairly straight port of the C version of "Tornado", release 1.2, written by Oliver Feiler and Rene Puls in or about 2000, which in turn appears to be the port of a C64 game of the same name.
